questionRef: 2019 HL Section L1 Q1–5 — complete section
questionText:
1. Why does the taxi driver recommend the Radisson hotel? Give two details.

2(i). What level of English does this caller have?

2(ii). How many people will be in her class?

3. Give two details about the patient’s symptoms.

4. Give two details about the plans these friends make for this evening.

5(i). Where does this caller want to go?

5(ii). How many passengers will be travelling in the taxi?

questionRef: 2019 HL Section L4 Q1–3 — complete section
questionText:
1(i). Give two details about Michael’s family.

1(ii). Give two details about the part‐time job Michael had when he was young.

2(i). Give one detail about the band that Michael formed during his teenage years.

2(ii). Give two details about why Michael says the age of 19 was the most difficult time in his life.

3(i). Give two details about Michael’s leading role in the film ‘300.’

3(ii). Give one detail about why 2014 was a significant year in Michael’s career.

rows.verbatim: • His father is German • His mother was born in (Northern) Ireland • Has (an older) sister/Kathrine • Family moved to Ireland
rows.contextNote: Give two details about Michael’s family.

rows.verbatim: • Michael worked as a waiter • General operator • In his father’s/family restaurant • Parents encouraged him to work hard
rows.contextNote: Give two details about the part‐time job Michael had when he was young. Source numbering: English booklet and scheme 1(ii); Irish column prints 2(ii) beside the same part-time-job question. Both original forms are retained.
